ops.body:
claudenative root-review fixes are complete (Run wf_56e12a0f-68f; cc-sync/claudenative-fixes @ f28d0e9ea622, fix 2c6e9b4 + refix f28d0e9). Hand-authored synthetic fixtures only; every reviewer scenario failed on 58fdc56 and passes now.
- (1) Queue enqueue records are ActivityNone. Activity is counted where the queued input is delivered (a user record origin, or a queued_command attachment origin/commandMode). A task-notification or peer delivery is autonomous, and a human queued prompt stays human.
- (2)/(3) Transcript and history.jsonl cursors share a FileStamp (inode/size/mtime/ctime). An unchanged file is not read. A file resumes incrementally only when it grew in place and its boundary digest matches; any same-size, shrink or new-inode change forces a full reparse. This also covers the astra-found case of a rewrite between the 4 KiB windows.
- (4) Per-directory sidecar cache (inode, mtime, count, subdirs); only recognized trees are read (subagents/ and tool-results/ recursively, workflows/ one level) and only when changed. Nested pdf page add/delete is detected. No whole-tree walk: an unrelated unreadable dir no longer fails the scan.
- (5) Autonomous = assistant, tool results, task-notification/peer inputs, and system scheduled_task_fire. All other system/attachment subtypes are ActivityNone (prompt_snapshot, environment, compact_boundary, turn_duration, etc.; the rule is documented on ClassifyRecord).
- Timing on the real ~/.claude (read-only, temporary test): 602 sessions, first scan 8.7 s, rescans about 24 ms.
- Deliberate trade-off (pinned by a test): a file that grew in place with an intact boundary but a rewritten middle resumes incrementally. Claude only appends, and restores use a new inode.
- Remaining for the phase-2 merge: F23 classification. -p/sdk prompts have no origin; promptSource sdk is classified as autonomous. Also decide how long to keep history-only state for sessions without a transcript yet.
